findings.description: The old code built a per-sensor calibration dict, so `source.load` ran once per distinct sensor. The new code calls `calibrated()` for each reading, and that calls `source.load`, which runs the SQL query. A batch with N readings now makes N queries instead of one per sensor, which is an N+1 pattern on a large batch.
findings.suggestion: Cache calibrations per sensor_id within `summarize`, for example with a local dict, and pass the cached Calibration to the range check.
findings.title: Calibration loaded from the database for every reading
